text: Local residents requested amendments to the existing parking regulations on the south side of Lowther Avenue, west of Avenue Road. The intent of this amendment is to prohibit standing within close proximity to the intersection and surrounding driveways in order to improve sightlines for motorists. Transportation Services staff have been consulted and have no objection to the proposed amendment.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Rescinded the existing parking prohibition in effect at all times on the south side of Lowther Avenue, between Avenue Road and a point 60.5 metres west. 2. Prohibited standing at all times on the south side of Lowther Avenue, between Avenue Road and a point 60.5 metres west.
